name: Canarys Automations Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1991, Canarys Automations 
Ltd is in the business of software & hardware development, consultancy services, electronic equipments, and handling water management system turnkey projects[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Canarys Automations Limited is a leading IT solutions provider with over 30 years in the industry, specializing in digital transformation for global businesses. With a workforce of more than 400 technology professionals, Canarys delivers tailored solutions across digitalization, modernization, automation, and intelligence domains.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 46.7% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 280 days.
